conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: While the original Turing Test focused on textual conversation, modern variations include evaluating AI in more complex, real-world scenarios. Some researchers now explore how AI performs in tasks requiring perception and interaction, moving beyond purely linguistic abilities.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
